policy_rows = data_rows('W0::Policy', {'B': 'number', 'C': 'number', 'D': 'number'}, 288, 291)
policy = [(num('W0::Policy', f'B{r}'), num('W0::Policy', f'C{r}'), num('W0::Policy', f'D{r}')) for r in policy_rows]

inc_rows = data_rows('W0::Incomes', {'B': 'string', 'C': 'number'}, 288, 293)
persons = []
for r in inc_rows:
    person = cell('W0::Incomes', f'B{r}')
    inc = num('W0::Incomes', f'C{r}')
    tax = 0
    for lower, upper, rate in policy:
        if inc > lower:
            tax += (min(inc, upper) - lower) * rate
    net = inc - tax
    persons.append((net, person))

persons.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))
result = persons[0][1]
